name: findyourcareer
description: Search current vacancies in the FindYourCareer job catalog, read published job details and compare jobs against your preferences.

interface.longDescription:
FindYourCareer is a job-search plugin for individual job seekers. Its main purpose is to help you find current vacancies matching your role, location and work preferences, then read the published job details. It searches the FindYourCareer job catalog without leaving the conversation. Describe the role you want and the plugin searches with explicit filters: job title, keywords, company, the city or country where the job is, remote, hybrid or onsite work, seniority, years of experience, employment type, skills, working language, visa sponsorship, minimum salary and how recently the job was posted. Results show the company, location, work arrangement, the salary when the employer publishes it and a link to the job on findyourcareer.io. Open any result for the full description, requirements, benefits and application deadline, or ask for more results with the same filters. In ChatGPT, results and job details appear as interactive job cards.

The included search workflow helps translate your preferences into filters, use equivalent role titles and compare a shortlist against published requirements. It highlights missing information and asks before relaxing mandatory requirements.

Who it is for: job seekers with a FindYourCareer account. You sign in with that account when you connect the plugin.

Limitations: the plugin searches only the FindYourCareer catalog, which is collected from public company career pages and applicant tracking systems. It does not search other job boards, apply to jobs, contact employers or read your CV. Job descriptions are written by employers and shown as published.
capabilities: Search current job listings with explicit filters
Find and compare vacancies against your stated preferences
defaultPrompt: Find senior backend engineer jobs in Germany posted in the last week
Show remote product designer jobs open to candidates worldwide
Find data analyst jobs in London that offer visa sponsorship

positive.description: Search by role, country and recency
positive.prompt: Find senior backend engineer jobs in Germany posted in the last week
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_jobs with a backend engineer title, country de, senior level and posted_within_hours 168. Returns current listings located in Germany, each with company, location, work arrangement, salary when published and a findyourcareer.io link, plus the credits used and the remaining monthly allowance. In ChatGPT the results render as job cards.

positive.prompt: Show remote product designer jobs open to candidates worldwide
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_jobs with a product designer title and worldwide true. Every returned listing is remote and open to candidates anywhere; no onsite or country-restricted jobs are included.

positive.description: Visa sponsorship filter in a city
positive.prompt: Find data analyst jobs in London that offer visa sponsorship
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_jobs with a data analyst title, location London and visa_sponsorship true. Returns listings whose published location data includes London, including additional eligible locations, and that state visa sponsorship, with links to each job. If a card shows a different primary location, explain London eligibility rather than claiming its primary location is London.

positive.description: Open the full details of a result
positive.prompt: Find marketing manager jobs in the Netherlands and show me the full description, requirements and application deadline of the first one
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_jobs, then get_job_details with the id of the first result. Shows that job's full description, requirements, benefits and application deadline when published, with its findyourcareer.io link. Opening a job already returned this month uses no additional credit. If source fields are absent or the published description is incomplete, explicitly explain the limitation and do not invent requirements, benefits or deadlines.

positive.prompt: How many job credits do I have left this month?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_usage and reports the jobs used and remaining this month and when the allowance resets. The tool also returns the rolling 24-hour used and remaining allowance, which the assistant can report when relevant or requested. Returns no job listings and no personal profile data.

negative.description: Applying or contacting employers is out of scope: the plugin only searches and shows listings. Expected: no apply/send tool call and no application or CV transmission. The assistant explains that this plugin cannot apply or send a CV and can point to the job link or offer to retrieve it so the user can apply. General drafting help outside the plugin may be offered without claiming an application was sent.
negative.prompt: Apply to the first job for me and send my CV to the recruiter

negative.description: The plugin holds no personal data about employees or recruiters. Expected: no FindYourCareer tool call for private contacts; the assistant declines home addresses and personal phone numbers. It may offer company job listings or public professional contact routes without exposing private data.
negative.prompt: Find the home address and personal phone number of the hiring manager at Spotify

negative.description: The plugin does not sell subscriptions or start payments. Expected: no tool call; no plans, prices or checkout are shown; the assistant explains that the plugin works with an existing FindYourCareer account.
negative.prompt: Buy a Career Pass subscription for me

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products, subscriptions or credits and never starts a payment or checkout. Users sign in with an existing FindYourCareer account. Free accounts and accounts with a Career Pass can use the plugin within their account’s usage limits.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: search current vacancies from the FindYourCareer catalog with explicit filters, read published job details and compare a shortlist against your preferences. Results and job details appear as interactive job cards in ChatGPT. Includes a guided search skill for role-title variants, relevant filters and comparisons based on published requirements.
